## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); confirmations: very weak sector breadth and major 1W/1M divergences among large caps (JPM, V, MA, LLY) support a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leads: AAPL (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +2.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND. Energy second: SLB (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +5.64%) ABOVE TREND. Third best (by relative 1W) is Communication where META (1W: +2.38% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND but GOOGL (1W: -2.50% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary lagging with RCL (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.57%) BELOW TREND, ROST (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak with MNST (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -52.97%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate weak with PSA (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +15.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +15.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk apparent.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.57%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -52.97%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.69% | 1M: +3.21%) CORRECTION, ROST (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select consumer and platform-exposed names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +15.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +15.49%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: multiple large-cap financials and healthcare show 1W/1M mismatch (JPM, V, MA, LLY), implying tactical noise not a broad breakout.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology showing strength but concentrated at the top; NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.92%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.50% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND. Sector is one of the two positive sectors this week (Technology positive among 2/11), so watch leadership breadth before adding exposure; Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials showing internal strain; JPM (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +1.20%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -0.79% | 1M: +3.81%) CORRECTION, PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W is negative overall and sentiment includes notable bearish headlines for PAYPAL and bank chatter; monitor for confirmation of broader weakness.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare soft with mixed catalysts; PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -6.03%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.23% | 1M: +0.83%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W is negative and idiosyncratic news (e.g., NVS trial pauses) raises risk for selective names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to high-conviction leaders in Technology and Energy while reducing exposure to over-concentrated momentum positions; monitor PYPL and RCL risk. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak overall breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.57%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -52.97%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology and Energy (the only 2 sectors positive this week; Breadth: 2/11). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare given weak 1W prints and headline risk in several names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through above recent swing highs to confirm broader tech advance. AAPL (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +2.66%) ABOVE TREND — watch hold of weekly gains as a bull confirmation. PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND — watch for failure to reclaim short-term support as trigger for deeper weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (+55): NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — bullish headlines on AI + rising price = confirming accumulation. PLTR (+45): PLTR (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +51.45%) ABOVE TREND — analyst support confirms strong momentum. MSFT (+45): MSFT (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND — positive AI capex chatter aligning with price strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PYPL (-60): PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND — bearish buyout reversal and price collapse are confirming. AMZN (-55): AMZN (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -4.35%) BELOW TREND — regulatory headlines confirm downside pressure. META (-45): META (1W: +2.38% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND — negative ad-safety headlines but price is rising, a notable divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
CRM, NVDA and SLB showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: narrow tech leadership and major 1W/1M divergences among large caps plus negative sentiment on PYPL could trigger uneven internals.
